title: Proton VPN: how to cancel your subscription and ask for a refund within 30 days
seoTitle: Proton VPN: how to cancel and ask for a refund in 30 days
description: How to cancel Proton VPN and ask for your money back, what the terms require, what is left out and how to avoid being caught by the automatic renewal.
metaDescription: How to cancel Proton VPN and ask for a refund: the 30-day window, the conditions that sink a request and how to avoid the renewal charge.
imageAlt: The Proton logo beside the words Proton VPN, 30-day refund, next to an official photo of a hand holding a phone with the Proton VPN app.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: To request a Proton VPN refund, first check who billed you and the initial purchase date. For direct purchases, cancel and contact support within 30 days, subject to the terms. Google Play and Apple purchases follow the routes below; cancelling a subscription alone does not return the payment.

contentSections.heading: Cancelling and asking for a refund are two steps
paragraphs: For VPN Plus, cancelling turns off future renewals. According to Proton's help center, paid features stay active until the next renewal date and the account then moves to the free plan. Cancelling alone does not return any money.

The refund is a separate request, made to support. Proton's terms of service, last modified on November 5, 2026, say that "the cancellation and the request for refund must both be addressed within the 30-day period". Someone who cancels on day 20 and only writes to support on day 35 has missed the window.

The general refund window and conditions also appear in the terms for plans such as Mail Plus and Unlimited. Cancellation effects differ: before downgrading another plan, check its requirements and effective date in your dashboard and the terms.

contentSections.heading: How to cancel the renewal on the website
paragraphs: The path below comes from the [Proton VPN help center](https://protonvpn.com/support/cancel-vpn-subscription), which we read on November 17, 2026. Button names are given as they appear on that page.
bullets: Sign in to your account at account.protonvpn.com.
Scroll down to **Cancel subscription** and click **Continue**.
Click **Cancel subscription**, read the terms Proton shows and click **Cancel subscription** once more.
Pick a reason and click **Submit**. According to the page, the cancellation only takes effect after this last step.
postParagraphs: With VPN Plus, the paid plan then stays active until the date it would have renewed. Past that date, the account still exists, on the free plan. Cancelling the subscription does not delete the account. If you change your mind, the dashboard shows a **Reactivate now** button.
The terms say that anyone who cannot reach the dashboard can cancel through Proton's customer support.

contentSections.heading: How to ask for the refund
paragraphs: If you subscribed on the website, ask support for the refund through the [Proton VPN support form](https://protonvpn.com/support/contact). Our suggestion is to write from the email address of the account that holds the subscription, name the plan and ask in plain words for the cancellation and the refund within the 30 days.

Under the terms, the refund is full, is paid in the original currency and to the original payment method, and is processed within 30 days of the request. The help center gives shorter time frames, depending on how you paid.

contentSections.heading: When the refund does not apply
paragraphs: The conditions below are in the terms of service. Any one of them takes a request out of the 30-day rule.
bullets: **More than 30 days have passed since the initial purchase.** Under the terms, the window runs from the first purchase, and a renewal charge falls outside it.
**You have already asked for a refund before.** The terms say refunds can only be requested once per user.
**You paid in cash or by bank transfer.** The terms say these payments are not refundable.

**You subscribed through an intermediary.** The rule covers people who subscribed through Proton's official channels, which are the website and the apps. If you bought from a third party, its refund policy applies.

**You disputed the charge with your card.** The terms say that anyone who relies on a dispute or chargeback through the payment processor waives the Proton refund and depends on the outcome of the dispute. The account may be suspended until the dispute is resolved.
**The account was terminated for violating the terms.** In that case, the terms say all payments and credits are lost.
postParagraphs: After 30 days, Proton's commercial policy does not provide an automatic refund; its terms leave any refund or credit to the company's discretion. This describes the commercial guarantee, not any other rights that may apply.

contentSections.heading: I subscribed in the app, through Google Play or the App Store
paragraphs: Check your receipt to see who took the payment: Proton, Google Play or Apple. Subscriptions billed by Google Play or the App Store are cancelled in that store; the refund routes are explained below.
bullets: **Google Play.** Open the Play Store app, tap your profile picture, go to Subscriptions and pick Proton VPN to cancel. For a refund within the 30 days, the help center says to contact Proton support and adds that it may also be possible to ask through Google Play itself.
**App Store.** On an iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, go to Subscriptions, pick Proton VPN and cancel. The refund is requested from Apple, at reportaproblem.apple.com.
postParagraphs: Before cancelling, check the receipt to see who billed you. If the receipt comes from Google or Apple, the cancellation is done in the store.

contentSections.heading: How to avoid being caught by the renewal
paragraphs: The renewal follows the billing cycle shown in the offer and receipt, which may differ from the initial term. The terms say you are charged "the then-current price valid at the time of the renewal", and a promotional price only covers the first period. On Proton's partner page in US dollars, the 2-year VPN Plus plan was billed at $59.76 for the first 24 months and then renewed at $83.88 every 12 months. Prices change with country and currency.

For VPN Plus, to stop the renewal, the terms ask you to cancel before the renewal date. There is no need to wait until the day before. Because the paid plan runs until the end of the period already charged, you can cancel right after subscribing and still use everything you paid for.
Put the next billing date in your calendar, a few days early. If you subscribed through a phone app store, check the date in the store's subscriptions.

contentSections.heading: Switching plans instead of leaving
paragraphs: If the plan turned out too big or too small for you, you can switch without leaving. The terms say that when you pick a new paid plan, the subscription changes right away and the unused part of the previous plan becomes account credit. A longer billing cycle, from 1 month to 1 year for example, only starts at the end of the current cycle. Under the terms, the refund window runs from the initial purchase.

contentSections.heading: If Proton does not answer
paragraphs: The support form is the official channel, and the help center says paid plans include priority support and chat. Keep the proof of purchase, the date you cancelled and the date you asked for the refund. Those three dates show the request came in on time.

Consumer protection rules in your country may give you a deadline of their own. Whether Proton VPN is a company to trust with your card is the subject of [Is Proton VPN safe?](/en/reviews/is-proton-vpn-safe).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Proton VPN give your money back? For direct purchases from Proton, the terms provide a full refund if you cancel and request it within 30 days of the initial purchase, once per user and subject to payment restrictions. For Google Play and App Store purchases, follow the route in the app-store section above.

How do I cancel Proton VPN? On the website, sign in, open Subscription, go to Cancel subscription and follow the steps until you submit the reason. If you subscribed through Google Play or the App Store, cancel in the store's subscriptions.

I cancelled and was still charged, what do I do? First check who billed you. A subscription bought through a phone app store is cancelled in the store. If the charge came from Proton after a completed cancellation, write to support with the dates and the receipt.
Can I get a refund for a renewal? The 30-day rule runs from the initial purchase, and a renewal falls outside it. After that window, the terms leave any refund at the company's discretion.
How long does the refund take? The terms say within 30 days of the request. The help center gives 5 to 10 business days for cards and 1 to 2 business days for PayPal.
